Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: NEW ORIGINAL medieval RTS woodcutter character, single directional walking-key-pose concept, matching our own building art.
Input image 1 is ONLY a STYLE/MATERIAL/CAMERA-ELEVATION REFERENCE, not the subject to copy. It shows our own lumberjack hut with round logs. Create its HUMAN worker, do NOT include any building or background scene.
Subject: one friendly but practical adult male woodcutter, sturdy shoulders and believable adult proportions, about 5.5 heads tall (NOT chibi, dwarf or muscular fantasy hero). Short chestnut-brown beard and hair, modest weathered face. Outfit identity to lock for future turnarounds: soft close-fitting rust-ochre wool cap, muted sage/olive-green knee-above work tunic, cream linen sleeves rolled to the elbows, plain dark-brown leather belt with small dull iron buckle, short split brown leather apron covering ONLY the front upper thighs, dark umber trousers and worn medium-brown ankle boots. Large readable color regions, few seams, no jewelry or decorative heraldry. Front of tunic has a simple short cream lace opening; back remains plain.
State: walking to work with EXACTLY ONE practical single-bladed WOODCUTTING AXE held low in his anatomical RIGHT hand, wooden handle, small matte iron head, not a battle axe. Left arm swings naturally. NO LOG, backpack, tool belt clutter, extra axe or tree.
Facing: SOUTHEAST / bottom-right of the screen, three-quarter FRONT view. Nose, chest, hips and toe direction all point diagonally down-right. Show face and one side. The body is walking in that direction, NOT looking back at viewer. One natural modest mid-step pose, no running, no attack.
Camera: FIXED elevated strategy-game camera looking DOWN noticeably from above, compatible with the roof/work-area nadhled of the supplied hut. Clearly see the TOP of his cap, top planes of shoulders and boots. Head slightly occludes upper chest from above. Orthographic-like projection, no horizon, no eye-level portrait viewpoint, no strong perspective, no camera tilt. Future directions rotate the person on the ground, NOT the camera.
Style: softly hand-painted volumetric medieval craft-game art matching the reference; matte warm timber, cream cloth, warm brown leather and restrained natural green. Painted clean edges with thin warm dark separation, no heavy black outline. Broad forms before detail; not photoreal, not plastic/mobile-game glossy, no tiny noisy textures. Neutral soft lighting, restrained local shading. The axe/cloth/skin should read when the human is later about 33 world pixels tall; this is a larger design master, not final pixel art.
Composition: one COMPLETE full-body worker centered on a warm off-white plain background, square canvas. Human body occupies about two thirds of canvas height with ample margins for later carried log. Show cap, both hands, axe and both boot soles entirely, feet near bottom center. No crop, vignette, environment, platform, cast ground shadow, floor line, logos, text, captions, arrows, grid, UI or watermark. Deliver ONE character, no multi-view sheet.
